say:2:1010309001:0.text: Why do people keep looking for me?

say:4:1010309002:0.text: Before the fire? I have no idea what you're talking about.
say:4:1010309002:0.source_cn: 火灾前？我听不懂你在说什么。
say:4:1010309002:0.male: Before the fire? I have no idea what you're talking about.
say:4:1010309002:0.female: Before the fire? I have no idea what you're talking about.

say:5:1010309003:0.text: If you're here to interrogate me, just save your breath.
say:5:1010309003:0.source_cn: 如果你也是来试探我的，大可以省省力气。
say:5:1010309003:0.male: If you're here to interrogate me, just save your breath.
say:5:1010309003:0.female: If you're here to interrogate me, just save your breath.

say:7:1010309004:0.text: Lord Franz didn't send you? Then that's all the more reason for me not to say anything.
say:7:1010309004:0.source_cn: 你不是弗朗茨老爷派来的？那我就更不能说了。
say:7:1010309004:0.male: Lord Franz didn't send you? Then that's all the more reason for me not to say anything.
say:7:1010309004:0.female: Lord Franz didn't send you? Then that's all the more reason for me not to say anything.

say:8:1010309005:0.text: I've already been paid, so don't expect me to say anything.
say:8:1010309005:0.source_cn: 既然已经收了钱，我就不会把那些事说出去。
say:8:1010309005:0.male: I've already been paid, so don't expect me to say anything.
say:8:1010309005:0.female: I've already been paid, so don't expect me to say anything.

say:10:1010309006:0.text: Hmph... I probably shouldn't have said that.

say:11:1010309007:0.text: I'll split a portion of my take if you promise not to tell Lord Franz.
say:11:1010309007:0.source_cn: 我把钱分你一点，你别告诉弗朗茨老爷。
say:11:1010309007:0.male: I'll split a portion of my take if you promise not to tell Lord Franz.
say:11:1010309007:0.female: I'll split a portion of my take if you promise not to tell Lord Franz.

say:12:1010309037:0.text: Instead of pestering me here, why don't you go look around where the fire happened?
say:12:1010309037:0.source_cn: 与其在这里问我，还不如自己去着火的地方看看。

say:13:1010309038:0.text: If you find something, Lord Franz might even reward you.
say:13:1010309038:0.source_cn: 如果能查出点什么，老爷说不定也会送你们一笔钱呢。

say:16:1010309008:0.text: Don't say it like that? I'm just choosing to keep Lord Franz's secrets.
say:16:1010309008:0.source_cn: 别说得那么难听，我是自愿替老爷保守秘密的。
say:16:1010309008:0.male: Don't say it like that? I'm just choosing to keep Lord Franz's secrets.
say:16:1010309008:0.female: Don't say it like that? I'm just choosing to keep Lord Franz's secrets.

say:17:1010309009:0.text: I don't care what his plan is for the wheat fields. I want to know when this lake will thaw!
say:17:1010309009:0.source_cn: 我不关心他想对麦田做什么，我只想知道映湖的冰什么时候能融化！
say:17:1010309009:0.male: I don't care what his plan is for the wheat fields. I want to know when this lake will thaw!
say:17:1010309009:0.female: I don't care what his plan is for the wheat fields. I want to know when this lake will thaw!

say:18:1010309010:0.text: I'm just a poor fisherman. Who would bother threatening someone like me?
say:18:1010309010:0.source_cn: 我只是一个穷渔夫，谁会闲着没事来威胁我？

say:20:1010309011:0.text: Of course not! Lord Franz is a generous man. He's even willing to help a penniless guy like me.
say:20:1010309011:0.source_cn: 当然不是，老爷可是大善人，还会接济我这样的穷人呢。
say:20:1010309011:0.male: Of course not! Lord Franz is a generous man. He's even willing to help a penniless guy like me.
say:20:1010309011:0.female: Of course not! Lord Franz is a generous man. He's even willing to help a penniless guy like me.

say:21:1010309012:0.text: Nonsense, they just want to learn my secret fishing techniques.
say:21:1010309012:0.source_cn: 别胡说，他们只是想找我学习钓鱼技巧罢了。
say:21:1010309012:0.male: Nonsense, they just want to learn my secret fishing techniques.
say:21:1010309012:0.female: Nonsense, they just want to learn my secret fishing techniques.

say:22:1010309013:0.text: Why would I be nervous? After all... you're not the first group of people that came looking for me.
say:22:1010309013:0.source_cn: 我有什么好紧张的……你们也不是第一波找来的人了。
